title: Associativity of canonical tensor pullback comparison
statement: Let $h:X_1\to X_0$, $q:X_2\to X_1$, $p:Z\to X_2$, $b:Z\to X_1$, $a:Z\to X_0$ and $d:X_2\to X_0$ be scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme] with $p;q=b$, $q;h=d$, $b;h=a$ and $p;d=a$. For any module $M$ on $X_0$ [def-pc-module-pullback], the canonical tensor composition comparisons $c$ [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso] satisfy $c_{p,d,a}(M);p^*(c_{q,h,d}(M))=c_{b,h,a}(M);c_{p,q,b}(h^*M)$. Both are maps $a^*M\to p^*q^*h^*M$.

source.place: Tags 0095, 0096 and 0097, definition and adjunction of module pullback and composition; Tag 01ZR first proof for local recovery.

proof.text: Use the six chosen tensor pullback adjunctions. For the four right-adjoint comparisons use pushforwardComp followed by pushforwardCongr of the supplied factorization. Their associativity square follows by module-morphism extensionality on opens: each component is a restriction map along an equality of opens, and functoriality composes these into the same map by subsingleton equality of open morphisms. Apply Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso_assoc, recorded by lem-sc-left-adjoint-composition-iso-associativity. Evaluate the inverse isomorphisms at M. The inverse of leftAdjointCompIso is precisely tensorPullbackCompositionIso.hom, by the definition of conjugateIsoEquiv and inversion.

proof_origin.place: Expanded coherence calculation in the existing recovery-transport proof; Tags 0095 and 0096 read online.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorPullbackCompositionIso_associativity
    {X₀ X₁ X₂ Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (h : X₁ ⟶ X₀) (q : X₂ ⟶ X₁) (p : Z ⟶ X₂)
    (b : Z ⟶ X₁) (a : Z ⟶ X₀) (d : X₂ ⟶ X₀)
    (wpq : p ≫ q = b) (wqh : q ≫ h = d)
    (wbh : b ≫ h = a) (wpd : p ≫ d = a) (M : X₀.Modules) :
    (tensorPullbackCompositionIso p d a wpd).hom.app M ≫
        (tensorPullback p).map ((tensorPullbackCompositionIso q h d wqh).hom.app M) =
      (tensorPullbackCompositionIso b h a wbh).hom.app M ≫
        (tensorPullbackCompositionIso p q b wpq).hom.app ((tensorPullback h).obj M)
